summary: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Logs which Better Roundabouts settings the engine rejects.
description: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Never publish this mod. Developer tool for square_roundabouts: on game load it asks the engine (makeProposalData) whether each combination of construction params could be placed, without building anything, and logs one [SQRB_PROBE] line per combination to stdout.txt. See plans/square_roundabouts/PROBE.md.
